# Influweb participant web app

Un sistema di partecipazione a base volontaria per il monitoraggio del COVID e dell'influenza in Italia

see [COUNTRY.md](COUNTRY.md).

## Shared code

This app is a thin country layer, most of it is shared with the other Influenzanet countries:

| Where | What | How to update |
|---|---|---|
| [`@influenzanet/case-web-app-core`](https://github.com/influenzanet/case-web-app-core) | app logic, pages, surveys | bump in the template |
| [`@influenzanet/participant-webapp-kit`](https://github.com/influenzanet/participant-webapp-kit) | bootstrap, Vite preset, `iframeEmbed` / `blogPosts` extensions | bump in the template |
| [`participant-webapp-template`](https://github.com/influenzanet/participant-webapp-template) | Dockerfile, nginx, CI, `vite.config.ts`, `index.html`, `package.json`, tsconfig, Makefile, this README, `example-public-folder/` | `make template` |

**Template-owned** files (header "Generated by participant-webapp-template") are overwritten by
`copier update`: change them in the template, or through an answer.
**Country-owned** files are created once and never touched again:

- `public/`: configs, locales, images (see [Content](#content))
- `src/`: `index.tsx`, `index.scss`, theme, country components (`src/configs` is a symlink to
  `public/assets/configs`)
- `.env`, `.env.*`
- `nginx/snippets/csp.conf`, `nginx/snippets/locations.conf`
- `COUNTRY.md`

### Pull template updates

Requires `copier` ≥ 9 (`pipx install copier`) and a clean git tree.

```sh
make template            # = copier update --trust: latest template tag
git diff                 # review; conflicts show up as <<<<<<< markers
yarn install && yarn build
```

The per-country values are the answers in `.copier-answers.yml` (don't edit it by hand).
Change one with `copier update --trust --defaults --data key=value`.

## Content

`public/` is served as is; `public/assets` is the content URL (`REACT_APP_CONTENT_URL`).

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `assets/configs/appConfig.json` | languages, profile avatars |
| `assets/configs/header.json` | logo, language selector |
| `assets/configs/navbar.json` | navbar items (left, right / user menu) |
| `assets/configs/footer.json` | footer columns and links |
| `assets/configs/pages.json` | routes: `defaultRoutes`, and per page `path`, `pageKey`, rows → columns → items |
| `assets/locales/<lang>/<pageKey>.json` | texts of a page; an item reads its `itemKey` entry |
| `assets/locales/<lang>/markdowns/`, `consent/` | markdown pages, consent texts |
| `assets/images/`, `assets/avatars/`, `assets/static/` | images, avatars, favicon |

`example-public-folder/` is a working, English-only example of all of the above. New country:
`cp -r example-public-folder public`. The template keeps it up to date, so diff against it after
an update to see new config options.

To add a language: add it to `appConfig.json` (`languages`), `footer.json` (language column) and the
language labels (`header`, `footer`, `settings`, `dialogs` locales), then add
`assets/locales/<lang>/` with the same files as `en/`.

### Kit extensions

Page items with `"type": "extension"` render a registered component; the kit registers these:

```json
{ "itemKey": "dashboard", "config": { "type": "extension", "config": {
    "type": "iframeEmbed", "url": "/dashboard/?lang={lang}", "title": "Dashboard" } } }
```

- `iframeEmbed`: `url` (`{lang}` is replaced), `autoResize` (default true, needs the
  iframe-resizer child script in the embedded page; otherwise set `false` and `height` /
  `minHeight`), `stylesheet` (same-origin only). A same-origin page must not be served with this
  app's CSP when `csp.conf` has `frame-ancestors 'none'` (the seed does): serve it from another
  service (ingress path) or from a `locations.conf` location that doesn't include
  `security-headers.conf`, and allow it in `frame-src`.
- `blogPosts`: latest Ghost posts; `ghostUrl`, `apiKey` (default `REACT_APP_GHOST_URL`,
  `REACT_APP_GHOST_CONTENT_API_KEY`), `blogUrl`, `limit`. Texts: `<itemKey>.title|readMore|viewAll|error|empty`.

Country-only extensions are registered in `src/index.tsx` (`extensions: [...]`).

## Configuration

- `.env` (committed): `REACT_APP_DEFAULT_INSTANCE`, `REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL`, languages,
  `REACT_APP_CONTENT_URL`, reCAPTCHA, title, description. `REACT_APP_VERSION` and the survey engine
  version come from `package.json`.
- Local overrides: `.env.local`, `.env.development.local` (git-ignored, standard Vite order).
- Per-environment values (staging vs production): `REACT_APP_*` values are baked in at build time,
  so an environment with different values gets its own image. Keep the production values in `.env`
  and only the differing keys in a committed `.env.<environment>` file, e.g. `.env.staging`, then
  build with it: `make docker ENV_FILE=.env.staging VERSION=v1.2.0-rc.1`, or the CI `env_file`
  input. The file is baked in as `.env.production.local`, which overrides `.env`.
  Don't name it `.env.production` (Vite loads that for every build, staging included) or
  `*.local` (git-ignored). Values that can be the same everywhere should be (e.g. one reCAPTCHA
  key listing both domains): one image then serves both environments.
- The CI writes `REACT_APP_DEFAULT_INSTANCE` from the `INSTANCE_ID` secret, if set, after the env
  file (it wins); with GitHub environments (`environment` input) each one can have its own.
- A local, git-ignored `.env.production.local` ends up in a local `make docker` build unless
  `ENV_FILE` replaces it.
- Content-Security-Policy: `nginx/snippets/csp.conf`, one `set $csp` per directive. The template
  sends it (enforced) on every response, adding `upgrade-insecure-requests` for https clients.
  When adding a third party, add it there and check every page in a browser.
- Extra nginx locations (proxies, redirects): `nginx/snippets/locations.conf`.

## Development

```sh
yarn install
yarn start        # http://localhost:5173
yarn typecheck
yarn build        # -> dist/
yarn preview      # serve dist/
```

The dev server proxies `/api` to `https://influweb.staging.influenzanet.info`, with websockets on /dashboard, /_stcore.
Change these with the `dev_proxy_target`, `dev_ws_proxy_paths`, `dev_path_proxies` answers.

## Docker image and deploy

- Local: `make docker` builds `influweb/participant-webapp:<latest git tag>` (`VERSION=...`,
  `ENV_FILE=...` optional). The image is nginx-unprivileged on port 8080.
- CI: run "Build docker image" (`.github/workflows/docker-image.yml`) manually. Inputs:
  `image_version` (always set it: empty means the latest git tag, possibly the one production
  runs), `env_file` (e.g. `.env.staging`), `environment`. Secrets: `DOCKER_USER`,
  `DOCKER_PASSWORD`, `DOCKER_ORGANIZATION`, `DOCKER_REPO_NAME`, optional `INSTANCE_ID`.
- Kubernetes: cluster-management, `svcWebParticipant` (with `unprivileged: true`).
